answer: What survives to the ridge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. A bridge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the signal of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
